scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:routes
scripts.test:lib: [ $(find lib -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l) -eq 36 ] || { echo 'ERROR: lib test-suite count changed. Expected exactly 36. A DROP means a suite was renamed/moved and silently stopped running (this guard exists because two suites did exactly that). An ADDITION means a new suite is not yet acknowledged. Either way, verify then update this number.'; exit 1; }; find lib -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 tsx --conditions=react-server --test
scripts.test:routes: [ $(find test/routes -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l) -ge 8 ] || { echo 'ERROR: found <8 route test files — a suite was likely renamed/moved (glob dropped it). If you intentionally consolidated, lower this floor.'; exit 1; }; find test/routes -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 tsx --conditions=react-server --test
